_readme: VOICE DEMO ONLY. Not part of the story: a test scene that shows Adrian's inner voices. Speakers voice:<skill> are inner voices.

demo_intro.speaker: narrator
demo_intro.text: [color=#8a8a8a]VOICE DEMO. Not part of the story: a test of Adrian's inner voices.[/color]

demo_psy_passive.speaker: voice:psychology
demo_psy_passive.text: He's sizing you up. Not for the job. For whatever comes after it.

demo_inv_passive.speaker: voice:investigation
demo_inv_passive.text: Fresh scrape across his knuckles. Someone told him no this morning.

demo_narr_go.speaker: narrator
demo_narr_go.text: He nodded once and left. Something close to respect.

demo_elo_passive.speaker: voice:eloquence
demo_elo_passive.text: Men like him love to be asked about the war. Ask him.

demo_psy_doubt.speaker: voice:psychology
demo_psy_doubt.text: [shake rate=10 level=5]Don't.[/shake] He's a shut door. Push and you lose him.

demo_ask_psychology.speaker: adrian
demo_ask_psychology.text: You don't like this job either.

demo_psychology_pass.speaker: tom
demo_psychology_pass.text: I don't have to like it. I owe the man.

demo_psychology_fail.speaker: tom
demo_psychology_fail.text: Don't tell me what I like, Vale.

demo_ask_investigation.speaker: adrian
demo_ask_investigation.text: Who told you no this morning?

demo_investigation_pass.speaker: tom
demo_investigation_pass.text: A door that didn't want opening. It opened.

demo_ask_eloquence.speaker: adrian
demo_ask_eloquence.text: You were over there, weren't you? France.
